methodology.selection: The 150 highest-scoring uniquely matched NCAA Division I institutions with complete official NCES metrics. Score = 0.65 × six-year bachelor graduation rate + 0.35 × full-time retention rate (both percentages). Sort descending score, then graduation rate, then retention rate; UNITID breaks remaining ties. Rank is ordinal among the qualified D1 candidate pool, not a published national all-college rank.
methodology.ranking: CollegeGuessr Academic Outcomes Index, 2023-v1. A custom outcomes index approved by the user; not a US News ranking or a comprehensive assessment of academic quality.
methodology.enrollment: IPEDS EF2023A EFALEVEL=1, EFTOTLT: total Fall 2023 enrollment
methodology.graduation: IPEDS DRVGR2023 GBA6RTT: six-year graduation rate, full-time first-time bachelor-seeking 2017 cohort
methodology.retention: IPEDS DRVEF2023 RET_PCF: full-time retention rate in Fall 2023, following the prior fall cohort
methodology.athletics: Official NCAA active-member directory, academicYear=2027 (2026–27), retrieved October 30, 2026; institutional primary conference, not football-only membership
methodology.missing: No selected school is missing a comparison field. Candidate schools without complete metrics or unambiguous NCAA identity are excluded. The index measures these two outcomes only; it does not measure faculty quality, research, selectivity or student learning, and is affected by student mix, resources and allowable exclusions.
